subject: Request for sandbox safety-net while purchase order completes
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@novamedhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novamedhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: keep sandbox active while PO completes

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from procurement — we're in the middle of an audit and the PO for the pilot is delayed. Finance estimates sign-off by July 13, but we don't want the evaluation to time out and lose momentum with our clinical stakeholders.

Can Redwood either: 1) freeze our sandbox countdown for one week, or 2) provision a short-term top-up (we'd prefer a freeze if possible)? We can share the PO draft now for reference (attached).

We're committed to moving forward; this is just a timing problem on our side. Appreciate any flexibility you can offer to keep the pilot running.

Thanks,
Anna Morales
VP, Clinical Programs
NovaMed Health

Attachments: novamed_po_draft.pdf (PDF, 212 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@novamedhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep sandbox active while PO completes

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO. Sorry to hear about the audit; totally understand the need to keep the pilot active.

We can help. Two options from our side:
- Freeze the trial timer for 7 days (no usage charged, environment stays available).
- Apply a one-time top-up of credits (we can provision a 2,000 token voucher) so your team can continue testing while finance wraps up.

If you prefer the freeze, we'll pause the countdown starting immediately and resume July 10. If you prefer the credit top-up, tell me which sandbox project to apply it to and I'll route it through billing.

I'm looping in Camila (Solutions) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to confirm internal approvals and get the paperwork squared away. Next steps:
1) Anna — confirm which option you want (freeze or top-up) and the sandbox name.
2) Camila/Marissa — please confirm we can authorize the 7-day freeze or the 2,000 token top-up for NB-7892.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0124

On Fri, Jul 3, 2026 at 09:12 AM Anna Morales <anna.morales@novamedhealth.com> wrote:

>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep sandbox active while PO completes

Jordan / Camila — approved.

Please apply the following for deal NB-7892 / NovaMed Health:
- Grant a 7-day trial freeze starting now (system flag to pause countdown).
- Provision a 2,000-token emergency voucher (voucher code to be used if they prefer credits instead of a freeze).

Action items:
- Camila: please attach the "redwood_trial_terms.pdf" (our short temporary terms) to the account and send a DocuSign link if Anna requests amended terms.
- Jordan: log this activity in HubSpot against NB-7892 and mark as "Temporary access granted: procurement delay."
- Ops/Billing: tag the voucher to NB-7892 and ensure no billing is generated while the freeze is active.

We should be conservative with credits but keep the pilot healthy — they're buying, so prioritize continuity.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal): redwood_trial_terms.pdf

From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@novamedhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novamedhealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep sandbox active while PO completes

Jordan / Camila — thank you so much, this is exactly what we needed.

We accept the 7-day freeze starting today. We'll keep you posted if finance asks for the voucher instead. PO should be routed to you by July 13 as planned — I'll send the final signed PO and confirm the sandbox project name once submitted.

Also — please send the DocuSign link for the temporary terms so our legal team can sign quickly (they prefer DocuSign).

Appreciate the quick turnaround and flexibility.

Best,
Anna
VP, Clinical Programs
NovaMed Health
